mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO sys_role_menu (id, tenant_id, role_id, menu_id, created_by, created_at) VALUES
(#{relation.id}, #{relation.tenantId}, #{relation.roleId}, #{relation.menuId}, #{relation.createdBy}, #{relation.createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_role_menu rm INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id AND r.tenant_id = rm.tenant_id WHERE rm.menu_id = #{menuId} AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT affected.tenant_id AS tenantId, affected.user_id AS userId FROM ( SELECT ur.tenant_id, ur.user_id FROM sys_role_menu rm INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = rm.role_id AND r.tenant_id = rm.tenant_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id AND ur.tenant_id = rm.tenant_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id WHERE rm.menu_id = #{menuId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND u.deleted = 0 UNION SELECT ur.tenant_id, ur.user_id FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id WHERE r.role_code = 'TENANT_ADMIN' AND r.built_in = 1 AND r.status = 'ENABLED' AND r.deleted = 0 AND u.deleted = 0 ) affected ORDER BY affected.tenant_id, affected.user_id

SELECT DISTINCT ur.tenant_id AS tenantId, ur.user_id AS userId FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id WHERE r.role_code = 'TENANT_ADMIN' AND r.built_in = 1 AND r.status = 'ENABLED' AND r.deleted = 0 AND u.deleted = 0 ORDER BY ur.tenant_id, ur.user_id
